text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"pets","kind":"count","span":"rabbits pets is twelve less than the combined number"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"cats","kind":"count","span":"two cats for every dog"},{"id":"q3","value":60,"unit":"dogs","kind":"count","span":"the number of dogs is 60"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q3","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"number of dogs times cats-per-dog ratio gives number of cats"},{"op":"add","args":["q3","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"dogs plus cats gives combined dogs and cats"},{"op":"sub","args":["s2","q1"],"out":"s3","note":"combined dogs and cats minus 12 gives number of rabbits"},{"op":"add","args":["s2","s3"],"out":"s4","note":"combined dogs and cats plus rabbits gives total pets"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"total number of pets in the neighborhood"},"dismissed":[]}
